title: Evaluation on paired inputs
statement: Let $F$ be a family of Boolean circuits, let $n$ be a natural number, let $r$ be a bit string, and let $v$ assign a bit to each of the $n$ input positions. The circuit in $F$ for inputs of length $2n+2+|r|$, evaluated on the input formed by duplicating each bit of $v$, then appending $01$ and $r$, outputs $1$ if and only if the paired encoding of the bit string specified by $v$ and $r$ belongs to the language accepted by $F$.
